title: Quiet Steps
tuning: E A D G B E
learningGoal: Maintain a sustained bass pulse while projecting a clear upper melody over arpeggiated middle notes.
practiceInstructions: Use thumb (p) for bass and i-m-a for the three upper strings. Start at 55 BPM, play four measures per phrase, then progress toward 76 BPM. No pick or percussion.
successCriteria: Eight complete measures at a steady tempo
Melody notes audibly stand out over inner arpeggio
No unintended muted strings or missed beats
